WP1.name: Information Explorer
WP1.purpose: Showcase all raw Information Layer data — crops, feeders, substations, projects, livestock, markets, policy and more.

WP2.name: Farm planning
WP2.purpose: Drive useful planning from that raw data using Indian farm-to-consumer knowledge: field & cost, suitable crops, shade impact of solar, nearest mandi/cold store/feeder/substation, and downloadable reports.

WP3.name: Monitoring & administration
WP3.purpose: Project users submit seasonal/quarterly updates; IAA reviewers approve/return; management analytics from approved records; system admins manage data/roles. Statuses: draft → submitted → returned → approved / published.
